newsitem.title: DUBAI: GCC foreign ministers to meet in Saudi next week.
newsitem.headline: GCC foreign ministers to meet in Saudi next week.

text.p: Foreign ministers of the six-member Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) will meet in Riyadh next week for their quarterly meeting, Gulf officials said on Tuesday.
Topping the agenda would be Israel's decision to build a new Jewish neighbourhood in mostly Arab East Jerusalem, a move which has drawn widespread criticism.
Saudi King Fahd on Tuesday said the decision violated the peace process agreements as well as the city's Islamic and Arab identity.
The GCC -- a political and economic alliance -- groups Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain and Qatar.
